items.title: CVE-2026-77690
items.description: ZohoCorp ManageEngine Key Manager Plus versions before 7151 were vulnerable to a Command Injection vulnerability that allowed authenticated users with certificate deployment privileges to execute arbitrary commands through specially crafted input when configuring a deployment target.

items.title: CVE-2026-11753
items.description: A vulnerability has been identified in armeria-saml versions prior to 1.41.1, where attacker-controlled RelayState is reflected into the HTTP Location header after successful authentication, allowing an unvalidated redirect to an attacker-controlled URL.

items.title: CVE-2026-11749
items.description: A vulnerability has been identified in armeria-saml prior to 1.41.1, where bearer assertions are not enforced for one-time use, allowing replay of previously consumed assertion IDs within their validity period.

items.title: CVE-2026-118983
items.description: The VikWidgetsLoader  WordPress plugin before 1.12.3 does not sanitise or escape several block attributes before outputting them inside HTML attributes, allowing users with the Contributor role to store arbitrary JavaScript that executes in the browser of any user viewing the affected post, including the administrator or editor who reviews the pending submission.

items.title: CVE-2026-118783
items.description: The All-in-One Video Gallery  WordPress plugin before 5.0.0 does not validate and escape some of its shortcode attributes before outputting them back in a page/post where the shortcode is embedded, which could allow users with the contributor role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-118637
items.description: The Simple Download Monitor WordPress plugin before 4.1.3 does not properly check the visibility of the content referenced by one of its shortcodes, allowing users with a role as low as Contributor to disclose the title and description of private, draft and other non-public posts.

items.title: CVE-2026-118523
items.description: The EventPrime  WordPress plugin before 4.3.6.1 does not keep the built-in Pending Review post status non-public, allowing unauthenticated users to view posts, pages and other content that are awaiting review.

items.title: CVE-2026-118422
items.description: The Stape Conversion Tracking WordPress plugin before 2.3.11 does not validate the sub-path appended to its same-origin proxy's upstream endpoint, allowing unauthenticated visitors to redirect the server-side request to an arbitrary host and have the response body and its content type returned from the site's own origin with security response headers stripped, leading to Server-Side Request Forgery, including loopback and internal hosts, and Cross-Site Scripting.

items.title: CVE-2026-118407
items.description: The Premium Packages  WordPress plugin before 7.3.1 does not verify that a user claiming a guest order is the original buyer, allowing any authenticated user to take ownership of any unclaimed guest order, and thereby read the buyer's billing details and download their purchased files, by supplying only the order identifier.

items.title: CVE-2026-118404
items.description: The Premium Packages  WordPress plugin before 7.3.1 does not verify ownership or session binding when loading a previously saved shopping cart, allowing any unauthenticated user who obtains another shopper's saved-cart identifier to load that shopper's cart contents, including selected products, quantities and buyer-entered custom field data, into their own session.

items.title: CVE-2026-118403
items.description: The Premium Packages  WordPress plugin before 7.3.1 does not verify that the requester owns a guest order before returning its details, allowing unauthenticated visitors who know a guest order's identifier to view its order status, payment status and total.

items.title: CVE-2026-115426
items.description: The WPvivid — Backup, Migration & Staging WordPress plugin before 0.9.138 does not properly validate a backup storage directory path before using it to create directories and write files, allowing administrators to cause those directories and files to be created outside the intended backup location via path traversal.

items.title: CVE-2026-115262
items.description: The Duplicator  WordPress plugin before 5.1.0, duplicator-pro WordPress plugin before 5.1.0 does not restrict its database charset and collation rewrite to schema statements during a restore, so a value a Subscriber stores in their own profile can break out of its string literal and inject SQL into the restore's INSERT statement when an administrator restores the backup onto a server lacking one of the source's charsets or collations.

items.title: CVE-2026-115257
items.description: The WP Roster WordPress plugin before 2.36 does not perform any capability or nonce checks before writing its stored roster data, allowing unauthenticated attackers to overwrite, wipe or restore the content of any roster.

items.title: CVE-2026-115250
items.description: The Text Typing  WordPress plugin before 2.2.2 does not properly sanitize and escape a block attribute before storing it and later outputting it into a page element that is read and rendered by client-side script, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks that execute in the browser of anyone viewing the affected page.

items.title: CVE-2026-115243
items.description: The WPvivid — Backup, Migration & Staging WordPress plugin before 0.9.137 does not validate the extension of the file it actually stores when handling an import upload: it checks the extension of a separate request field while saving the uploaded file itself with WordPress's upload type-checking disabled, so an authenticated administrator can store a file with an arbitrary extension, including a PHP file, in the WPvivid — Backup, Migration & Staging WordPress plugin before 0.9.137's import directory. This is an incomplete fix of CVE-2025-5961, whose extension check was applied to the wrong value.

items.title: CVE-2026-115242
items.description: The WPvivid — Backup, Migration & Staging WordPress plugin before 0.9.137 does not sanitize the staging destination folder supplied to its staging-start handler, applying only a generic text filter while the sibling writability-check handler applies the correct filename sanitizer, so an authenticated administrator can supply a path containing traversal sequences and make the WPvivid — Backup, Migration & Staging WordPress plugin before 0.9.137 write the copied site files outside the WordPress installation directory.

items.title: CVE-2026-115241
items.description: The WPvivid — Backup, Migration & Staging WordPress plugin before 0.9.137 does not verify that a submitted snapshot identifier names a snapshot it actually created before using it as a database table-name prefix, so an authenticated administrator can supply the site's table prefix, or any other string, and cause the WPvivid — Backup, Migration & Staging WordPress plugin before 0.9.137 to drop every matching table, including the core WordPress tables, destroying the site's database.

items.title: CVE-2026-114431
items.description: The Enable Media Replace WordPress plugin before 4.2.3 does not pass a replaced media file through the WordPress upload pipeline, so the upload prefilter that SVG-sanitizer Enable Media Replace WordPress plugin before 4.2.3 rely on never runs, allowing an authenticated user with upload access to store an SVG file containing script that executes when the file is opened directly. It requires an SVG-enabling Enable Media Replace WordPress plugin before 4.2.3 to be active, as the replace path otherwise rejects SVG uploads.

items.title: CVE-2026-112244
items.description: The Duplicator  WordPress plugin before 5.1.0, duplicator-pro WordPress plugin before 5.1.0 does not prevent direct access to some of its bundled PHP files, which initialise without their expected context, trigger a fatal error, and return a stack trace that discloses the server's absolute filesystem paths to unauthenticated users.

items.title: CVE-2026-112243
items.description: The Duplicator  WordPress plugin before 5.1.0, duplicator-pro WordPress plugin before 5.1.0 does not sanitise and escape a parameter before reflecting it on one of its administrative pages in certain configurations, leading to Reflected Cross-Site Scripting that executes in the session of a logged-in administrator who is tricked into opening a crafted link.

items.title: CVE-2026-111962
items.description: The WP Remote Users Sync WordPress plugin before 2.2.0 does not adequately restrict access to the user export files it writes beneath the public web root, relying on an Apache access-control file that other web servers such as Nginx ignore, which allows an unauthenticated attacker who requests the export's predictable file name while it is present to retrieve the exported users' personal data.

items.title: CVE-2026-111740
items.description: The Post Duplicator WordPress plugin before 3.0.17 does not check whether the requesting user may view each post before returning a list of posts for a post type, allowing users with a role as low as Contributor to read the titles and hierarchy of other users' draft and private posts.

items.title: CVE-2026-110964
items.description: The Essential Real Estate WordPress plugin before 5.3.5 does not verify that a media attachment belongs to the requesting user before deleting it, allowing a self-registered customer-level user to delete other users' media library attachments, including those owned by administrators.

items.title: CVE-2026-110692
items.description: The PowerPack Addons for Elementor: Widgets, Form Styler and Templates WordPress plugin before 3.1.3 does not validate a user-supplied URL before using it in a server-side HTTP request, which could allow users with the contributor role and above to perform Server-Side Request Forgery attacks against internal and loopback resources and read the response back.

items.title: CVE-2026-108068
items.description: The FV Flowplayer Video Player WordPress plugin before 7.5.56.7212 does not perform proper authorization checks on one of its video-migration functions, which is protected by a nonce only, allowing users with Contributor-level permissions and above to disclose and bulk-modify the FV Flowplayer Video Player WordPress plugin before 7.5.56.7212's stored video records across the whole site.

items.title: CVE-2026-108067
items.description: The FV Flowplayer Video Player WordPress plugin before 7.5.56.7212 does not properly verify record ownership before modifying or deleting stored video and meta records, allowing authenticated users with Contributor-level access and above to modify or delete arbitrary records belonging to other users, and to disclose the associated meta data in the response.

items.title: CVE-2026-108041
items.description: The SEOPress  WordPress plugin before 10.4 does not sanitise and escape some of its analytics tracking settings before outputting them in an inline script printed on every front-end page, allowing users granted a SEOPress  WordPress plugin before 10.4 capability that an administrator can delegate to lower-privileged roles to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks that execute in the browser of any site visitor, including a logged-in administrator viewing the front end.

items.title: CVE-2026-106649
items.description: The Kali Forms — Contact Form & Drag-and-Drop Builder WordPress plugin before 2.4.29 does not prevent users with author-level access and above from storing arbitrary JavaScript in a form button configuration, which is later output into a JavaScript execution context and runs in the browser session of any user who clicks the button, including an administrator.

items.title: CVE-2026-106000
items.description: The Booking Package WordPress plugin before 1.7.34 does not require payment to be completed before saving a booking on calendars configured to require online payment, allowing unauthenticated users to create confirmed bookings without paying.

items.title: CVE-2026-105413
items.description: The Form Maker by 10Web  WordPress plugin before 1.15.51 does not consistently escape user-submitted field values before rendering them on its submissions admin page, allowing unauthenticated users to store a payload that executes as arbitrary web scripts in the session of an administrator who views the submissions.

items.title: CVE-2026-105191
items.description: The ERP: Complete HR, Accounting & CRM Suite Built for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 1.17.11 does not perform a capability check on an AJAX action that returns the stored before-and-after values of a record change, allowing any authenticated user, including Subscribers, to read other users' sensitive HR, CRM and Accounting data by enumerating record identifiers.

items.title: CVE-2026-104719
items.description: The CookieYes  WordPress plugin before 3.5.8 does not correctly restrict who can write its cookie-category script fields, and does not sanitize or escape them, allowing users with the Contributor role to store JavaScript that executes in the browsers of site visitors and of an administrator reviewing the content.

items.title: CVE-2026-101166
items.description: The Mollie Payments for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 8.2.0 does not verify a product's publication status before creating an order for it through its PayPal express-checkout endpoint, allowing unauthenticated users to order draft or unpublished products.

items.title: CVE-2026-101165
items.description: The Mollie Payments for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 8.2.0 does not verify an order's payment state or the requested payment gateway before removing a configured payment-surcharge fee, allowing unauthenticated users to reduce an order's total before completing payment.

items.title: CVE-2025-11229
items.description:
The system fails to properly enforce scope authorization when the `authorize_all_scopes` configuration is enabled. This allows applications using the client credentials grant type to obtain all API scopes, including sensitive internal and console scopes, without requiring explicit authorization, bypassing intended access controls.

Exploitation of this vulnerability can lead to privilege escalation, enabling unprivileged clients to perform unauthorized administrative actions, access confidential organizational data, and potentially achieve full account takeover in deployments where the `authorize_all_scopes` configuration deviates from its default disabled state.

items.title: CVE-2026-105296
items.description: Multiple Akeeba products lack the anti-CSRF check on some actions. If the user access a malicious page while logged into the product, unintended operations may be performed.

items.title: CVE-2026-80335
items.description: In the bootloader download module, there is a possible out-of-bounds write due to a failure to reset a global offset variable during firmware update sessions. This could lead to heap memory corruption, system crash, or potential arbitrary code execution with no additional execution privileges needed.

items.title: CVE-2026-79405
items.description: In Modem Firmware, there is a possible system crash due to improper input validation of dedicated PUCCH configuration. This could lead to remote denial of service with no additional execution privileges needed.

items.title: CVE-2026-121803
items.description: Rejected reason: This CVE ID is a duplicate of CVE-2026-80335 (VULN-002 dl_download_midst) and has been rejected.

items.title: CVE-2026-121802
items.description: @better-auth/expo before 1.7.16 allows certain account-takeover outcomes (e.g., unauthenticated changes of any account's email address), because it signs a caller-supplied state value without checking whether that value had been issued by the server. NOTE: the application secret must be rotated after updating to a fixed version.

items.title: CVE-2026-121618
items.description: A weakness has been identified in Linksys E5600 1.1.0.26. This affects an unknown part of the file /cgi-bin/fqc.cgi of the component Factory Quality Control. This manipulation causes information disclosure. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

items.title: CVE-2026-121617
items.description: A security flaw has been discovered in Linksys E5600 1.1.0.26. Affected by this issue is the function init_multipart of the file /cgi-bin/upload_fw.cgi of the component Header Parser. The manipulation results in out-of-bounds write. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

items.title: CVE-2026-121616
items.description: A vulnerability was identified in Linksys E5600 1.1.0.26. Affected by this vulnerability is the function strcpy of the file /cgi-bin/mesh_login.cgi of the component JSON Request Parser. The manipulation of the argument username/password/token/source/cn/action leads to out-of-bounds write. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

items.title: CVE-2026-121615
items.description: A vulnerability was determined in Linksys E5600 1.1.0.26. Affected is an unknown function of the file /cgi-bin/mesh_login.cgi of the component Login Handler. Executing a manipulation can lead to improper authentication. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

items.title: CVE-2026-84730
items.description:
Stack-based buffer overflow in certain ASUS Router firmware allows an unauthenticated nearby attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges via a crafted device name.
Refer to the '
Security Update for ASUS Router AiCloud Feature ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

items.title: CVE-2026-84729
items.description:
Out-of-bounds write in certain ASUS Router firmware allow an unauthenticated nearby attacker to write data beyond the intended buffer or potentially cause a denial-of-service (DoS) via a crafted packet.
Refer to the ' 
Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware  ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

items.title: CVE-2026-121610
items.description: A security flaw has been discovered in funadmin 7.1.0. Impacted is the function Curd::selectList of the file /frontend/ajax/index of the component Frontend List Endpoint. The manipulation of the argument selectFields results in sql injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-121609
items.description: A vulnerability was identified in Qihoo 360 Whole Home Router M5 4.0.17.1566. This issue affects the function Home of the file /etc/init.d/mpt of the component Boot Script. The manipulation leads to hard-coded credentials. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-121608
items.description: A vulnerability was determined in Qihoo 360 D603-2, D600-2 and D606-6 up to 6.3.2. This vulnerability affects the function on_push_message of the file /fs2/bin/iscm of the component Timezone Push Handler. Executing a manipulation of the argument tz can lead to os command injection. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. Upgrading to version 6.4.0 is able to resolve this issue. Upgrading the affected component is advised. Firmware 6.4.0 gates the path with a new check_timezone_parameter validation (verified by VulDB vulnerability analysis team via disassembly).

items.title: CVE-2026-121607
items.description: A vulnerability was found in Qihoo 360 D603-2, D600-2, D606-6 and D706 up to 6.4.9. This affects the function testspeed_command of the file /fs2/bin/iscm. Performing a manipulation of the argument host results in os command injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-112116
items.description:
An exposed IOCTL with insufficient access control in ASUS System Control Interface allows a local, low-privileged user to read and write arbitrary physical memory through crafted device control requests, ultimately resulting in a complete compromise of the affected system.
Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS System Control Interface ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

items.title: CVE-2026-110464
items.description:
Missing authorization in ASUS Armoury Crate allows a local attacker to write content into a specific file or registry location with Local System privileges, or to cause a recoverable system crash, via the service's exposed inter-process interface.
Refer to the '
Security Update for Armoury Crate App ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

items.title: CVE-2026-121606
items.description: A vulnerability has been found in Qihoo 360 D621-2, D603-2, D600-2, D619, D606-6 and D706 up to 6.4.9. Affected by this issue is the function verify_sign of the file fs2/bin/iscm of the component Firmware Signature Verification. Such manipulation of the argument sign leads to improper verification of cryptographic signature. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-121600
items.description: A flaw has been found in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. Affected by this vulnerability is the function setMacFilterRules of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component MAC Filter Handler. This manipulation of the argument addEffect causes stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-121599
items.description: A vulnerability was detected in TOTOLINK A950RG 4.1.2cu.5268_B20221104. items.title: CVE-2026-120651
items.description:
CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl allow an infinite loop on a short request body when $DISABLE_UPLOADS is set.

When $CGI::PUTDATA_UPLOAD or an upload hook is set, read_postdata_putdata takes a request body that is not a form submission. With $CGI::DISABLE_UPLOADS set, it discards the body by reading until Content-Length bytes have arrived. Once a body shorter than its Content-Length runs out, every read returns 0, so the loop never ends.

A client can keep a server process spinning with one such request.

items.title: CVE-2026-120650
items.description:
CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl allow memory, CPU and disk exhaustion via missing or unenforced request size, parameter and upload limits.

$CGI::POST_MAX defaults to no limit, and when set is not enforced for chunked multipart bodies or for the boundary line of a multipart body without a boundary= parameter. Bodies saved as PUTDATA, POSTDATA or PATCHDATA uploads are read into memory in one go, and nothing limits the number of parameters or uploads.

items.title: CVE-2026-120648
items.description:
CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl allow HTML injection via text containing --> in comment.

Arguments are placed between <!-- and --> without escaping, so text containing --> closes the comment early.

An application that passes request data to comment can be made to inject HTML into the page.

items.title: CVE-2026-120647
items.description:
CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl allow Content-Disposition parameter injection via unescaped double quotes in the header attachment filename.

header(-attachment => $name) writes $name into the quoted filename parameter of Content-Disposition without escaping double quotes.

An application that passes request data as the attachment name can be made to send a second filename parameter, changing the name the response is saved under.

items.title: CVE-2026-120646
items.description:
CGI versions from 4.71 before 5.00 for Perl allow denial of service via a plain string dereferenced as a symbolic reference in uploadInfo.

uploadInfo dereferences its argument and calls its filename method without checking that it is an upload filehandle. A plain string naming a defined global variable, such as the parameter value from ?upload=0, is treated as a symbolic reference, and the method call on it dies.

items.title: CVE-2026-120645
items.description:
CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl allow denial of service via submitted values used as a regex for optgroup selection in scrolling_list.

When rendering option groups, scrolling_list marks the selected options by interpolating each selected value, by default taken from the request parameters, unescaped into a substitution pattern.

A client can make the request die with an invalid pattern, or tie up the process with one that backtracks heavily.

items.title: CVE-2026-120644
items.description:
CGI::Cookie versions before 5.00 for Perl allow cookie attribute injection via unvalidated path, domain and expires values.

The path, domain and expires values are written into the Set-Cookie header without checking for semicolons or control characters.

An application that sets them from request data can be made to add other cookie attributes, such as Domain or SameSite.

items.title: CVE-2026-120643
items.description:
CGI versions from 4.62 before 5.00 for Perl allow cross-site scripting via a raw apostrophe in URLs returned by url and self_url.

Both pass the URL through URI's canonical method, which leaves an apostrophe in the path raw and decodes the %27 that query parameter escaping produces, so an apostrophe in the request path or a parameter appears raw in the result.

An application that places the URL in a single-quoted HTML attribute or JavaScript string is open to cross-site scripting.

items.title: CVE-2026-120642
items.description:
CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl return request-derived values untainted under taint mode.

The upload filename, uploadInfo values, some path_info and script_name values, Accept results, and the name lists from url_param and cookie are returned without the taint flag, as is a cookie named expires from 4.67 on.

These values come from regex captures or hash keys, which Perl does not taint, so they pass -T checks unvalidated.

items.title: CVE-2026-120641
items.description:
CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl return upload filenames with any client-supplied path, including ../ and Windows paths.

The name returned for an uploaded file is the filename parameter of the part's Content-Disposition header, unchanged.

An application that saves the upload under this name can be made to write outside the intended directory.

items.title: CVE-2026-120640
items.description:
CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl allow the POSTDATA, PUTDATA, PATCHDATA and XForms:Model parameters to be set from the query string or form fields.

CGI stores a non-form request body under POSTDATA, PUTDATA or PATCHDATA, and an XForms body under XForms:Model, but also accepts these names from the query string, a form field or a multipart part, so an application cannot tell a client-sent value from the real body.

A cross-site HTML form can post POSTDATA={"admin":true} to an endpoint that reads JSON from param('POSTDATA'), a request forgery that needs no CORS preflight.

items.title: CVE-2026-120639
items.description:
CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl allow HTTP header injection via entity decoding after the newline check in header and unchecked values in multipart_start and do_push.

With autoEscape off, header decodes HTML entities in extra header values after its newline check, so an encoded CR or LF reaches the response. multipart_start does not check header values for newlines, and do_push does not check the type it prints in each part.

An application that passes request data into these header values can be made to add headers or split the response.

items.title: CVE-2026-120638
items.description:
CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl allow open redirects via HTML entity decoding of the URL after application validation in redirect.

redirect decodes HTML entities in its URL before writing the Location header, so a URL the application has already validated can change meaning. For example, //evil.example/ becomes //evil.example/ and sends the user to another host.

items.title: CVE-2026-120637
items.description:
CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl take request parameters from the process command line arguments for an unrecognised REQUEST_METHOD.

For a REQUEST_METHOD such as OPTIONS, CGI falls through to its offline debugging mode, which is on by default, and builds the parameters and path_info from the process's command line arguments.

items.title: CVE-2026-120636
items.description:
CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl allow open redirects and script injection via URLs built from REQUEST_URI in url and start_form.

url(-absolute=>1), url(-relative=>1) and the default start_form action are built from the client-supplied REQUEST_URI without validation. The result can be protocol-relative (//evil.example), absolute-form (http://evil.example/) or contain backslashes, and url(-relative=>1) can return a javascript: URL. Links and form posts built from these URLs can go to another host.

items.title: CVE-2026-120635
items.description:
CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl allow form fields to be smuggled past proxies and WAFs via multipart parsing that differs from the RFCs.

The multipart/form-data parser matches the boundary anywhere rather than at the start of a line, uses the boundary without its leading -- for some client-supplied User-Agent values, finds the Content-Disposition name and filename inside the quoted values of other parameters, and corrupts parts when the boundary nears the 4096-byte read size.

items.title: CVE-2026-120634
items.description:
CGI::Carp versions before 5.00 for Perl leak warnings across requests in persistent environments via the warningsToBrowser buffer.

Warnings are held in a package-level buffer until warningsToBrowser writes them into the page as HTML comments, and the buffer is never cleared between requests. Under mod_perl, FastCGI or PSGI, warnings from one request are written into a later one.

Warnings that contain one user's request data can appear in the HTML sent to another user.

items.title: CVE-2026-120633
items.description:
CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl trust the client X-Forwarded-Host header in url, self_url, virtual_host and virtual_port.

These take the host name and port from the X-Forwarded-Host request header when present, and otherwise from Host, without validating either. The URLs from url and self_url are the default redirect location and the start_html(-base=>1) base href, and the default start_form action when REQUEST_URI is not set.

A client can poison shared caches, and URLs the application stores or sends, with redirects, links and scripts that point at a host it controls.

items.title: CVE-2026-120632
items.description:
CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via a backtracking regex on the XForms multipart/related Content-Type.

When a POST Content-Type contains multipart/related, the boundary and start parameters are extracted with an unanchored pattern that puts .+ on either side of the boundary capture, which backtracks in cubic time on a header that does not match. No request body is needed.

items.title: CVE-2026-120631
items.description:
CGI::Cookie versions from 4.67 before 5.00 for Perl allow denial of service via the client cookie expires value used as a regex in parse.

CGI's cookie method reads the Cookie request header through parse, which interpolates the header's expires value unescaped into the substitution pattern that removes it from the cookie string.

A client can make the request die with an invalid pattern, or tie up the process with one that backtracks catastrophically.

items.title: CVE-2026-121614
items.description: Docker Sandboxes versions 0.31.0 before 0.50.0 do not neutralize repository-controlled Git configuration when running certain host-side Git commands. An attacker who can modify a host repository's Git configuration, for example through a direct-mode sandbox with the repository mounted read-write, can configure core.fsmonitor or another Git setting that invokes an external program. Git can execute the program during a later clone-mode fetch or, starting in version 0.39.0, an sbx kit push initiated by the user. The program runs on the host with the invoking user's permissions, outside the sandbox's microVM isolation. The read-only host repository mount provided to a clone-mode sandbox does not itself allow that sandbox to modify the host repository's Git configuration. The issue is fixed in version 0.50.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-95860
items.description: node-opcua is an OPC UA implementation for TypeScript and Node.js. From 2.42.0 until 2.180.0, namespace-level access control configured through setDefaultRolePermissions is not honored by the runtime enforcement path for nodes without explicit per-node RolePermissions. SessionContext.getApplicableRolePermissions reads a missing or null DefaultRolePermissions metadata value instead of the configured namespace field, and the null result is treated permissively. An anonymous network client can consequently write variables with CurrentWrite access or call bound methods when an operator configured a restrictive namespace default and relied on inheritance. Servers with no declared policy, nodes with explicit per-node permissions, and correctly bound programmatic namespace metadata are outside the authorization-bypass case. This issue is fixed in version 2.180.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-76894
items.description: CKAN MCP Server is a tool for querying CKAN open data portals. Prior to 0.4.112, the DataStore table UI in src/resources/datastore-table-ui.ts accepts window message events without validating event.origin and sends JSON-RPC messages through postMessage with a wildcard target origin. A frame that can reach the embedded document can inject fabricated fields or records, spoof pending ui/initialize responses, disrupt the MCP UI handshake, or receive outbound messages when the resource is embedded by an untrusted parent. Values are HTML escaped, so the demonstrated content injection is display spoofing rather than script execution, and exploitability depends on the host embedding model. This issue is fixed in version 0.4.112.

items.title: CVE-2026-64672
items.description: Terragrunt is a flexible orchestration tool that allows Infrastructure as Code written in OpenTofu or Terraform to scale. Prior to 1.1.1, the terragrunt catalog command derives a predictable per-repository catalog clone root under the shared system temporary directory and follows a symlink already placed at that path. A local attacker who can write to the temporary directory and predict the cataloged repository can redirect cleanup and cloning outside the intended root, causing an existing repository-named directory to be deleted and replaced in the victim's security context. The attack requires the victim to run terragrunt catalog on a shared host while the symlink is present, and it is not remotely exploitable. This issue is fixed in version 1.1.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-61497
items.description: TinyUSB before 0.20.1 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in the HID host report descriptor parser tuh_hid_parse_report_descriptor() in src/class/hid/hid_host.c that allows a malicious USB device to trigger an out-of-bounds read by subtracting an item size from the remaining descriptor length without validating the item fits within the remaining buffer. Attackers can present a crafted USB device with a truncated report descriptor causing the uint16_t desc_len value to underflow, resulting in out-of-bounds memory reads and denial of service on the host system.
